notes.title: Patch Notes - 1 Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=YDMOYF9_Q7E;full][/previewyoutube]

The Anniversary Update for Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game is here!

Don’t forget to take advantage of the DOUBLE XP event and Twitch Drops ongoing right now!

New Klown - Dollie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/b8310db602c0ec0d372dc0624fbd7302a35a31de.jpg
Dollie is a larger-than life figure, always at the center of circus mayhem with her oversized striped shoes and vibrant patchwork suit. She delights in crafting elaborate pranks that leave her victims bewildered, like her signature acid pies that explode into a colorful, gooey mess. With a wild mane of hair that defies gravity, Dollie’s infectious laughter echoes through the night, drawing in unsuspecting victims who become the punchline of her chaotic jokes. Her love for slapstick humor knows no bounds, making her an unstoppable force in her twisted carnival of horrors. 

Dollie is a special character skin for the Tank Klown type and is purely cosmetic

Now Available In The Store

The following cosmetics are now available in the store!

Humans
Characters

 Debbie Stone
 Mike Tobacco

Cosmetics

 Towel

Klowns

 Slim
 Bibbo
 Frank
 Magori
 Hot Diggity Dog
 Sundaze
 Fryzo
 Meatstack
 Cheezy


New Space Suit Klown Cosmetic Pack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/f1826b4fae2b4bf865ad968ac137534a7579c25d.jpg

As the alien invasion intensifies, the remaining humans prove to be increasingly formidable. Just in the nick of time, reinforcements descend, and these otherworldly Klowns join the fray, still clad in their spacesuits. This cosmetic bundle offers 5 unique spacesuit designs, each with 11 distinct color variations. 

These items are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.

Big Discounts
The Infernal Klowns and Human Summer Outfits Pack are on sale! 

Don’t miss out on this limited time offer in the in-game store!

New Challenges
We’ve introduced 12 new Challenge books for Human and Klown players to complete. 

That’s over 80 new challenges in total!

Accompanying these new challenge books is over 40 new cosmetics as well as XP rewards to help you level up!

“No Strings” Klowntality
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/a640df29215146a77c83482a643b125b471db648.jpg
Klownzilla has been unleashed.

The No Strings Klowntality is now live and free for all Klown players

Patch Notes

Humans

 Increased Human base walking speed
 Increased Human base crouch speed

Item spawn adjustments
Energy Drink

 Reduced Energy Drink spawn count per map

Popsicle

 Reduced Popsicle spawn count per map


Klowns

 Increased base stamina for all Klowns
 Fixed an exploit where the Klown player could use the emote wheel to cancel the recovery frames after an attack


Jawbreaker Mace

 Reduced damage for the Jawbreaker Mace’s primary attacks
 Increased damage for the Jawbreaker Mace’s charged attack


Klown Trick LOL

 Increased LOL Duration
 Increased LOL Movement Speed buff
 Reduced LOL Cast Time
 Increased LOL Self Heal 


Klown Trick Klown Jump

 Reduced Klown Jump unlock time
 Reduce Klown Jump cooldown time


Cocoon/Hooking adjustments

 Increased Cocooning Humans point rewards
 Increased Cocooning Humans assist point rewards
 Increased Hooking Cocoon point rewards
 Increased Hooking Cocoon assist point rewards

Human Mall Jobs DLC

Holiday Klown Tint Haul!

NEW Chiodo Brawler - Okie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/d96584e917f1ae07d4ee33c607c940355964700a.jpg
Okie, the self-proclaimed "deadliest clown in the galaxy," is the older brother of Shorty and the mischievous twin of the elusive Dokie. Born on a planet where cream pies double as weapons and balloon animals bite back, Okie's hobbies include long walks on short piers and acid pies for two. One thing's for sure—if Okie's around, terror is never far behind!

Available now in the in-game store!

notes.title: Patch 1.6.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/7eab84907eea886733f938e701a28be1176aea28.png

Crescent Cove Mall
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/f7e6fd9239b4d95249192959f6a1d16adc9bddaf.jpg
Shop til you drop (dead) in this 80's neon retail utopia! Peruse through the trendy stores while you run for your life! Stop by the salon so you can look your best for the Klownpocalypse! There's no shortage of shops, eateries, and entertainment as you wind through the different wings and levels of the Crescent Cove Mall!

Human Halloween Outfit Pack - Individual Cosmetics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/81097f7fef6f7f067847b7ce48c399fe25e089fc.jpg
Players now have the option to purchase individual character cosmetics from the Human Halloween Outfit Pack.

[hr][/hr]
Changes and Improvements

General

Adjusted and improved the in-game store for better readability
Added Menu UI SFX while navigating the News and Shop menus

Humans

Adjusted inventory sorting so small items will now move from the Big Pocket inventory slot to an available small item slot when Humans pick up two-handed weapons
Added support for WASD control during Lucky Duck and Out of Shape Hand of Fate minigames
Added barefoot movement SFX for Humans equipped with cosmetics that have bare feet
Added the ability to open doors while holding a Gas Can

Human Weapons

Reduced the attack range of all Human melee weapons 
Adjusted Human melee weapon hitboxes to prevent Humans from being able to hit Klowns while facing the opposite direction

Klowns

Each cocoon hooked up to a Lackey Generator now reduces overall Klown respawn timers by 1.5 seconds
Added a respawn timer display while spectating a dead Klown teammate
Lackeys will request to carry cocoons from Klowns after seeing a Klown carry a cocoon

Klown Weapons

Slightly increased Laser Beamer cottonization damage

Bug Fixes

General

Various Crash Fixes
Fixed an issue where the party host’s Quickplay lobby could appear as a black screen with only the lobby HUD elements displayed
Fixed an issue where a duplicate of the cap of a cocoon could appear twice when a Human escapes from a cocoon
Fixed an issue where Humans and Klowns were spawning too close to each other on Waterfront Pier
Fixed an issue where a Private Match could be started with no Klowns
Fixed an issue where Loadout 1 would be highlighted when Show Loadouts menu was reopened in the Lobby screen after a new Loadout was selected
Fixed an issue where voice lines could be cut off while attacking or emoting in quick succession
Fixed an issue where WASD controls could not be used to update settings across various Settings Menu options
Fixed an issue where Xbox Series X|S users with an unlinked EGS account could receive an 'Anti-Cheat Login Failure!’ after accepting an invite while the game was suspended

Humans

Fixed an issue where a Human could replace a dead Bot when a live Bot was available when joining a match in progress
Fixed an issue where the Boat could escape without any Humans when a Human driving the Boat hit “Drive Away!” and “Exit Boat” simultaneously
Fixed an issue where Humans could not sprint while carrying a Gas Can
Fixed an issue where Humans could not escape from a certain Terenzi Truck exit on Downtown Crescent Cove
Fixed an issue where various attacks to Slappy’s and Impy’s head would display the incorrect color hitmarker
Fixed an issue where Humans could use the Airhorn while downed
Fixed an issue where the Spectator’s HUD could persist during the intro cinematic after rejoining a match
Fixed an issue where Bots would drop guns from their inventory after replacing a Human player
Fixed an issue where Human footstep SFX would not play for a player that joined a match in progress

Klowns

Addressed an exploit where Klowns were able to fully replenish their health and cooldowns
Fixed an exploit where Klowns could move Gas Cans
Fixed an issue where Klown skin and makeup could appear faded
Fixed an issue where the Klown Jump map Fog of War could not be uncovered on certain areas across various maps
Fixed an issue where a Human could be Klowntalitied and cocooned simultaneously
Fixed an issue where Gobstopper Flail attacks would not damage Humans
Fixed an issue where the Gobstopper Flail would not always extend during an attack combo
Fixed an issue where the third swing in a melee attack combo would not occur while repeatedly hitting the attack button 
Fixed an issue where the Klowntality Menu could not open while the LOL Trick was active
Fixed an issue where Klown Trick cooldowns could appear reset after canceling the Pizza Box transformation in a Private Match
Fixed an issue where closing the game while performing a Klowntality on a Bot could cause the Bot to become invisible
Fixed an issue where the LOL Trick VFX could persist while another Klown was performing a Klowntality
Fixed an issue where the '+100 XP Discover Human' could be rewarded when a Human left and rejoined a match
Fixed an issue where after being assigned to a lobby as a Klown, the player could sometimes see the Human’s pre-match lobby 
Fixed an issue where a Klown could be slightly knocked back after being hit from a thrown Bridge Key or Key Card
Fixed an issue where Elvira’s hair would remain attached to her body after being decapitated

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/f3a0ca656c596f5d3fd718576190ed6f210bcabe.png

[strike]Xbox Series X|S users
Patch 1.5.0 is coming, but it is still in the approvals process. Please keep an eye on our socials to be informed of when the patch will be ready for Xbox. Apologies for the delay, everyone is working hard to push it live.

Visual Issue Regarding Tickets
Purchasing Tickets will not immediately update the amount of available Tickets displayed on the UI. Please restart your game until the correct amount of Tickets are being displayed.[/strike]

The issues listed above have been resolved. Thank you for being patient while we were getting the needed approvals and fixes in.

What's New in 1.5.0!

Patch 1.5.0 has released, and with this patch we are bringing some big gameplay and content changes, including a new in-game store AND updates to mini-games, emotes, loadouts, balance, bug fixes, and more!

New DLC - Elvira & Tom Savini
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/df1697050d70da86f90274131332053eabf4a96e.png
Elvira - This 'Mistress of the Dark' is ready to grab a tool and start knocking some Klowns’ blocks off. You could be playing as Elvira in Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game right now.

Tom Savini - Tom Savini is here and ready to SPLATTER some Killer Klowns.
Play as this icon of horror today!

New Mini-Games
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/00360f99afe750357caa29e1a8a3d2437d48dd4a.png
Out of Shape - Rotate puzzle pieces into place in this unscrambling game!

Lucky Duck - Pay attention, as you will need to match pairs of numbers in this memory game!

Spray 'N’ Play - Pump up your water gun to push your boat to victory in this racing game!

New Emote - Unforgettable Moves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/775cfebb544e67af867f5366217f8b27f4786c52.png
Whether you're destroying all humans, or escaping an alien invasion, sometimes you gotta stop everything you're doing and bust a move. Dance like no one's watching!

Loadout Swapping
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/20a92f30dfdffcedffc4d725ac084234642be78b.png
You are now able to switch between your different loadouts while in a lobby, with extra time given so you can come best prepared for the invasion!

New In-Game Store
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/7312e1e5f8474e3d9e191022f5a12cc774399333.png
Game DLC's are now conveniently located and purchasable in-game using Tickets. You can navigate to the store straight from the main menu! Click here for more details.

New Store FAQ

[hr][/hr]
Changes and Improvements

General
Humans

When joining a match-in-progress, players will now replace Bots (if available) and take over the Bot’s loadout, inventory, and stats

Players will spawn in with their own selected loadouts when the next match begins
Players cannot replace a different dead or escaped player or bot
If the player is joining a match that they had previously disconnected from, they can take over the Bot that had replaced them.

If the player had died or escaped, the player will remain dead or escaped upon rejoining the same match


Added a notification that lets Humans know that the Terenzi Truck escape will not be an option when an Early Klownpocalypse is triggered by hooking up 16 cocoons to all Lackey Generators
Humans will now get up with additional health after recovering from being downed 
Added impact effects for Human weapons when hitting environmental objects 

Klowns 

Klowntalities now unlock after the first 3 minutes of a match (reducible by hooking up cocoons) 
Added a 15 second cooldown after performing a Klowntality 

Bug Fixes
General

Fixed an issue where players on Xbox Series X|S could not join parties after accepting an invite while the game was closed or in a suspended state
Fixed an issue where players on Xbox Series X|S could communicate with non-friends on other platforms when they have Communication Settings set to ‘Friends Only’
Fixed an issue where the camera could become stuck after opening the Emote Menu and performing another action
Fixed an issue where the horizontal camera controls would be inverted after setting their Controller Preset to Southpaw
Fixed an issue where the Emote Menu controls would be inverted after inverting Horizontal/Vertical Camera settings
Fixed an issue where the player count for Humans would show a player dying when they had escaped

Humans

Fixed an issue where a match could start with less than 7 Humans if Human players left while the match was loading
Fixed an issue where if two humans vaulted over opposite sides of one obstacle at the same time, one of their character models could get stuck facing in the direction they vaulted towards
Fixed an issue where thrown items could hit Klowns without causing damage
Fixed an issue where thrown items would not display the correct colored hitmarker when hitting a downed Klown's head or nose
Fixed an issue where thrown items could hit above a downed Klown's head hitbox
Fixed an issue where the First Aid Kit could remain in a Human’s inventory after being used
Fixed an issue where dropped melee weapons could be flung away by physics
Fixed an issue where Humans could appear to move erratically in place after respawning during a match
Fixed an issue where Bots could get stuck inside a locked room
Fixed an issue with headshots not always registering on Lackeys wearing balloon dog hats
Fixed an issue where Bots could have duplicate names

Klowns

Fixed an exploit where Klowns could refresh the cooldowns on Klown Tricks
Fixed an exploit where Klowns could not be hit while selecting a Klowntality
Fixed an issue where the camera could become stuck after performing 3 Klowntalities in a match
Fixed an issue where Klowns could become locked out of swinging the Mallet if they were stunned after using the last attack in the Mallet Combo
Fixed an issue where the cottonization progress bar would sometimes disappear while cottonizing a Human
Fixed an issue where the Balloon Dog Trick could not be used while the Klown Jump was on cooldown
Fixed an issue where the Popcorn Bazooka's reload animation could play while the cottonization weapon was equipped
Fixed an issue where the fog on the Klown Jump map would not clear while exploring using the Pizza Box Trick
Fixed an issue where Klown nameplates would not displayed while using the Pizza Box Trick
Fixed an issue where Klowntality Menu controls would be inverted after inverting Horizontal/Vertical Camera settings
Fixed an issue where camera controls were not locked while the Klowntality menu is open

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/2081e3c0e2cb83b775e542287329f3f7d3306672.png
NEW Map - Waterfront Pier
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/e32a85321b88eaf60892c351606a05dc1f1c2604.png
Nothing quite says Summer like taking a trip down to Waterfront Pier! Built for fun in the sun with all the classic boardwalk thrills, this multilevel beachside destination brings joy to all who visit. Take in the breathtaking sights and smells of a Klown invasion pushed to this seaside paradise!

Click here to watch the Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game | Waterfront Pier Map Reveal on YouTube!

NEW DLC - Fatso
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/b07ba0809b46b436b15e528117f6da8a5e522858.png

The beloved, rotund brother of Chubby, Fatso makes short work of invasions so he can get back to feasting on human delicacies. Fatso is a special character skin for the Tank Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080640/Killer_Klowns_From_Outer_Space_Fatso/

NEW Unlockable Cosmetics for ALL Klowns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/f93c1b91a68453e498334e8557b7af374256f11a.png
46 NEW Klown tints are now unlockable on your way up through level 150

Button Remapping Is Now Available

Button remapping is now available for players under the new CONTROLS section under the Settings menu.
Customize your controller and keyboard/mouse inputs with your personal preferences so you can improve your skills as both Humans and Klowns!

Changes and Improvements
Humans

Made several adjustments and fixes to the Strength stat to accurately reflect what is displayed in their respective Archetype selection page
Addressed and adjusted hit detection against Klowns with various weapons and thrown items 
Improved Human spawn placement after escaping cocoons
Bots will now fill-in for Human players that have left during the match

Bots that replace a Human player will keep that players inventory
Bots that replace a Human player will drop any Escape Items they are carrying upon filling in
Players that fill-in for Bots will take over that Bot’s inventory

Added controller vibration for the following occurrences:

Being cottonized
Interacting with Doors and Windows
Using any consumable item
Entering or exiting Hiding Spots
Throwing items
Picking up weapons
Swapping weapons
Charging weapons
Failing QTEs


Klowns 

Made several adjustments and fixes to the Strength stat to accurately reflect what is displayed in their respective Klown Type selection page
The Klown Jump map will now show and mark Human escape routes that have been discovered by other Klown players
Adjusted and polished animations while holding the Mallet
Adjusted and added SFX when hitting Humans with the: 

Pentashot
Lazerbeamer

Added controller vibration for the following occurrences:

Taking damage from firearms
Weapons are overheated
Swinging the Klown mallet
Throwing cocoons
Performing Klown Tricks
Swapping weapons
Charging melee weapons
Shooting ranged weapons

Bug Fixes
General

Various crash fixes
Addressed an issue that was causing lobbies to have more than 7 Humans or 3 Klowns in a game
Fixed various issues where players could be placed on the opposing team after joining on a friend’s matchmaking lobby
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in certain areas of Top Of The World
Fixed an issue where players’ feet and items could clip through the ground in certain areas of The Suburbs
Fixed an issue where the Push To Talk button would not work properly on Steam Deck
Fixed an issue where certain UI elements in the settings menu were not displaying properly after being interacted with

Humans

Fixed an exploit where players were able to duplicate certain items
Fixed an issue where a Human’s camera could become stuck after holding the Portal escape open and letting 3 other players escape
Fixed an issue where the Human team maximum would be reduced from 7 players to 6 players if a dead or escaped Human left the match

Please note: Patch 1.3.2 is now available. This resolves a specific crash within 1.3.1 and 1.3.0. Patch 1.3.0 notes are below.

We’re still reeling from a very action-packed launch period, and we’ve been having a blast playing with the community and seeing all of the celebratory streams and amazing Klowns cosplays!

Since launch, we’ve been regularly putting out updates and DLC’s, and we appreciate all your feedback as we continue to support your enjoyment of Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game!

Today we released Patch 1.3.0 which focuses on general fixes and QOL improvements. Here are some highlights from today’s patch:


A new very rare Player Resurrection Card that will bring you back to life if drawn during Hand Of Fate
Human players can now drop items while cocooned
Players will now be able to see their teammates’ health and stamina while in Spectator Mode
Addressed an issue where the Elite Klown challenge book would not unlock after completing all other Klown challenge books
Addressed an issue where the Elite Human challenge book would not unlock after completing all other Human challenge books

We’ve also made updates to matchmaking, HUD, and more! Read the patch notes for in-depth details.

Read the Patch Notes

Thank you for playing Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game, and stay tuned as we’ve got some exciting content updates coming your way.

The Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game Team

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/fc08085d49a54419937c2fa7f298f2ce57459cc2.png
New DLC Cosmetics
Human Summer Outfit Pack
The sun is out, and the beaches of Crescent Cove are brimming with energy! Gear up for the Klown invasion with this assortment of summer themed human cosmetics! This DLC includes summer themed tops, bottoms, hats, and eyewear. All items are purely cosmetic and do not alter gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921250/Killer_Klowns_From_Outer_Space_Human_Summer_Outfit_Pack/?curator_clanid=42850130

Infernal Ranger
As a Dark Jester, more than just laughter is needed to satisfy this Klown. Nothing is more funny to Slappy than the sounds of humans fleeing in terror. Slappy is a special character skin for the Tracker Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921240/Killer_Klowns_From_Outer_Space_Infernal_Tracker__Slappy/?curator_clanid=42850130

Changes and Improvements
General

The Matchmaking Preference System is now available 
Added an accessible In-Game Friends List to the Pause Menu while in a match
In the private match menu, the Map Selection buttons are now clickable 
Disabled door interactions while doors are mid-animation
Updated Klownpocalypse VFX
Player HUD will now be hidden at the end of a match

Gameplay

Introduced a delay to stamina regeneration for all Klowns and Humans
Increased total stamina pools and stamina regeneration for all Klowns and Humans
Adjusted spawn points so Humans and Klowns should no longer spawn or resurrect near each other

Humans

Made adjustments and fixes to the Human Archetype stats
Increased drop rates on Hand of Fate card rarities. Players will now have increased odds for better drops
Adjusted and polished animations for:
Human movement while crouching
Gas Can interactions
Bunker Keypad interactions

Klowns

Increased EXP Rewards for:
Cocooning a Human
Assisting in cocooning a Human
Hooking a cocoon containing a live Human
Hitting a Human with a cocoon
Adjusted and polished animations for:
Klown Mallet combo
Klown Raygun
Invisible Car left and right turning 
Improved Lackey pathing so Lackeys are less likely to get stuck
Bouncecaster projectiles will now explode upon impact with Lackeys
Added some visual flashing to the progress bar while cottonizing an objective 
Added a camera angle for Shoe customization
Adjusted SFX of the Mallet Charge attack

Klown Types

Klown Type “Trapper” renamed to “Hunter”
Game balance was hindered noticeably with Klown Traps, and at the end of the day it is about making the best game experience for everyone. The name change came to better represent the Klown Type.
Increased the Tank Klown’s walk and run speed 
Increased the Hunter Klown’s total stamina pool
Increased the Ranger Klown’s walk and run speed
Reduced the Stamina Drain on the Brawler Klown
Adjusted the Brawler Klown’s Stamina stat display
Reduced the speed of backwards sprinting on Klowns
Reduced the speed penalty from light stuns on Klowns

Klown Weapons

Increased damage of the Gobstopper Flail’s primary melee attacks
Improved hit detection on the Gobstopper Flail

Klown Tricks

Increased LOL Trick’s healing speed 
Adjusted the LOL Trick to start its duration timer after the casting animation completes
Adjusted the Balloon Dog Trick to start its duration timer after the casting animation completes

Bug Fixes
General

Various crash fixes
Fixed an issue that was causing Challenges to not track or complete while playing on dedicated servers
Fixed an issue where players would appear to fall through the floor when vaulting or silently crossing windows
Addressed an issue that was causing lobbies to have more than 7 Humans in a game
Fixed an issue where players joining a match in-progress would incorrectly see the Bridge escape barricaded after it had already been opened
Fixed an issue where players joining a match in-progress would incorrectly see the Bunker escape as usable, after it had already been used
Fixed an issue where players were not able to save their Party Privacy settings 
Fixed an issue where players could take fall damage upon spawning or respawning
Fixed an issue that was causing interaction animations to not play properly for hosts
Fixed interact animation not playing for the host when stopped and quickly started
Fixed an issue where a Human’s character model would appear in front of a hiding spot for a moment before exiting the hiding spot 
Fixed an issue where interaction UI could get stuck on a player’s screen if the interaction was interrupted or moved out of range
Fixed and polished various audio issues
Fixed an issue where the Portal escape VFX would only appear for the host of the match
Fixed an issue where players were able to rotate their characters in the customization menu even after they had let go of the left-mouse-button
Fixed an issue where players were not seeing voice transcriptions if they were not the host of the lobby
Fixed an issue where voice transcription text was popping up from audio that was playing out of range of players

Klowns

Fixed an issue where Klowns were able to see Flashlights when in the Klown Jump View Mode
Fixed an issue where the Pentashot would not properly cottonize Humans while they were being grabbed by a Lackey 
Fixed an issue where the firing animation for the Gigaray would sometimes not properly play 
Fixed an issue where Klowns were not able to use the Pizza Box Trick in certain areas
Fixed an issue where Klowns could get soft-locked if they tried to use the Pizza Box Trick while picking up a cocoon at the same time
Fixed an issue that was causing a Klown’s VOIP to stop working properly after they used the Pizza Box Trick
Fixed an issue where Klowns could not see other Klown’s name tags
Fixed an issue where sometimes while trying to Klown Jump indoors, Klowns were not receiving a prompt telling them you cannot jump indoors 
Fixed an issue where Klowns could get EXP for hitting a dead Human body with a thrown cocoon
Fixed an issue where if the Tank was carrying a cocoon, the “Drop” icon would flash

Humans

Fixed an issue where Humans would get stuck after being grabbed by a Lackey and then stunned by a Klown
Fixed an issue where the Human’s walk animation would not play correctly after being Lured out of a Boat
Fixed an issue where ammo amounts would be randomized if ammo was dropped from inventory
Fixed an issue where Human cameras could get stuck zoomed in after crouching and aiming using a Revolver or Shotgun
Fixed an issue where Human escape animations were playing incorrectly 
Fixed an issue that was causing Humans to see incorrect camera angles while hiding in a hiding spot 
Fixed an issue where stamina would continue to drain while hiding in a hiding spot
Fixed an issue where Humans would see remaining health after they had been killed
Fixed an issue where dead Human players could not spectate Bot Humans
Fixed an issue where Humans would not receive a hitmarker for hitting Lackeys with guns
Fixed an issue where, as a Human dropping your melee items could sometimes make them stand up vertically 
Fixed an issue where Humans would appear standing up after Emoting while waiting in the Boat escape
